title: Even McLaren Is Building an SUV Now
extract: McLaren has confirmed its first SUV as part of a £500 million UK investment programme that will expand production and bring powertrain development in-house. The high-performance SUV is intended to broaden McLaren's range while retaining a hybrid focus.

title: Ferrari's Universo Experience Exhibition To Open In New Delhi
extract: Ferrari’s Universo exhibition will make its Indian debut at Yashobhoomi in New Delhi from October 17 to November 1. The exhibition will present Ferrari’s heritage, racing history, classic cars and technology.

title: Linux Kernel Build Times Ready To Be Significantly Reduced With Latest Patches
extract: A new revision of Linux kernel build optimisations could cut incremental build times by around 70% and no-op builds by roughly three quarters. The work targets single-threaded bottlenecks across the kernel build system and has shown gains on AMD and Apple Silicon systems.

title: Google's "Painful To Maintain" Binder C Linux Driver Being Removed In Favor Of Rust
extract: Google is preparing to remove the long-standing C implementation of Android's Binder IPC driver from the Linux kernel in favour of its Rust rewrite. The Rust implementation has reached feature parity and is reported to match or exceed the C driver's performance.

title: CISA Flags Three Actively Exploited Linux Kernel Flaws, Orders Federal Patch by Sunday
extract: Three Linux kernel vulnerabilities have been added to the US Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue, with US federal civilian agencies given a short remediation deadline. The flaws affect separate kernel subsystems and have confirmed evidence of active exploitation.

title: Vixen Gameboy Demake - October 2023 Prototype
extract: A developer has published an archived Game Boy prototype of Vixen, a homebrew demake inspired by the 1988 ZX Spectrum and Commodore 64 game. The prototype helped inspire a later completed Game Boy Color port.
